release_read.basis: Release discloses crude sales halted by the sole downstream purchaser in early October and management 'evaluating all options to resolve near-term working capital constraints' with a TLB refinancing pending, against revenue $154.4M (below the ~$157-184M consensus range) and 27k bopd; Sep-30 cash of $38.0M is better than the $21.6M the thesis feared and Hondo restart is still slated for November, so sized at under half the 18.3% implied move given a 28% short and a 50% 20-day slide.

release.released_at_note: Exhibit 99.1 to 8-K dated 2026-11-09, scheduled before market open; exact time not stated in the exhibit

key_line.detail: Crude sales halted by the sole downstream purchaser in early October 2026; new sales to three LA-area refineries started in early November; company 'evaluating all options to resolve near-term working capital constraints', TLB refinancing contemplated; 16.1M ATM shares sold in Q3 at ~$4.75; Hondo inspections and first production scheduled for November.

guidance.detail: No formal guide change; only forward figure is all wells flowing to sales in December at ~10,000 gross bopd tied to the Hondo restart.

call.detail: Call at 11:00 ET, inside the session: liquidity/refinancing questions land after the open; a refinancing or buyer announcement is upside risk to a short.

public_reaction.summary: No dated headline about this morning was found in the time available; one search returned only older SOC sell-off stories.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 0.5951 vs prev close 1.93 (-69.2%), about 3.8x the 18.3% implied move and far past the -8% release read; active pre-market (159 prints, 31 in the last 30 min, last at 09:19, not stale); range 0.3756-2.03. The market is pricing a distress/restructuring outcome that the release language ('working capital constraints', purchaser halt) makes possible but does not state outright.

thesis_check.note: The short thesis was liquidity and volume; the release confirms both (sales halted in October, working-capital constraints), though the cash figure is better than feared.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is active and recent, so the open should hold most of a -69% gap; a gap this far beyond the implied move tends to give part of it back, and a short-covering bounce is likely with 28% of the float short, before the 11:00 call.

recommendation.reason: De short staat voorbeurs al bijna 70% in de winst, veel meer dan de cijfers op zichzelf rechtvaardigen en bijna vier keer de verwachte beweging. Zo'n extreme daling geeft na de opening vaak een deel terug (veel shortposities die moeten dekken), en om 11:00 volgt de call, waarin nieuws over herfinanciering de koers kan opstuwen. Neem de winst bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als er voor 09:30 een bericht komt over een faillissementsaanvraag (Chapter 11) of een aandelenverwatering, kan de koers verder dalen en is vasthouden tot de sluiting te overwegen.
